subject.title: Sessions panel: sort by last meaningful activity, not just last message

question: Should Sessions ordering use a read-time meaningful-activity projection or persisted activity timestamp fields, and which event classes count as meaningful activity?
rationale: Source proves the current gap, but the durable choice affects Gateway RPC shape, row write load, parent/child rollup semantics, UI labels, and compatibility with current `updatedAt` listing/pruning behavior.

options.title: Read-time projection
options.body: Derive meaningful activity and reason from bounded recent transcript/event metadata and child rows at list time, avoiding extra writes from noisy background activity.

options.title: Persisted activity fields
options.body: Add durable `lastEventAt`, `lastMeaningfulActivityAt`, and `lastVisibleConversationAt` fields with tested row updates, rollups, and migration/doctor handling.

options.title: Narrow UI-only polish
options.body: Keep ordering on `updatedAt` for now and only improve labels/previews, leaving the meaningful-activity model for a later design item.

recommendation.title: Read-time projection
recommendation.body: Derive meaningful activity and reason from bounded recent transcript/event metadata and child rows at list time, avoiding extra writes from noisy background activity.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest recent owner across the Sessions UI, gateway row contract, and session-management surfaces that would absorb this choice.
